import ctypes as c, hashlib, os
from pathlib import Path
from ctypes import wintypes as w

shell32=c.windll.shell32
ole32=c.windll.ole32
user32=c.windll.user32
gdi32=c.windll.gdi32

class GUID(c.Structure):
    _fields_=[("Data1",c.c_uint32),("Data2",c.c_uint16),("Data3",c.c_uint16),("Data4",c.c_ubyte*8)]
def guid(s):
    import uuid
    u=uuid.UUID(s)
    b=u.bytes_le
    return GUID.from_buffer_copy(b)

ids={
"Desktop":"B4BFCC3A-DB2C-424C-B029-7FE99A87C641",
"Documents":"FDD39AD0-238F-46AF-ADB4-6C85480369C7",
"Downloads":"374DE290-123F-4565-9164-39C4925E467B",
"Pictures":"33E28130-4E1E-4676-835A-98395C3BC3BB",
"Music":"4BD8D571-6D19-48D3-BE97-422220080E43",
"Videos":"18989B1D-99B5-455B-841C-AB7C74E4DDFC",
}
shell32.SHGetKnownFolderPath.argtypes=[c.POINTER(GUID),w.DWORD,w.HANDLE,c.POINTER(c.c_wchar_p)]
shell32.SHGetKnownFolderPath.restype=c.c_long
ole32.CoTaskMemFree.argtypes=[c.c_void_p]

class SHFILEINFOW(c.Structure):
    _fields_=[("hIcon",w.HICON),("iIcon",c.c_int),("dwAttributes",w.DWORD),("szDisplayName",c.c_wchar*260),("szTypeName",c.c_wchar*80)]
shell32.SHGetFileInfoW.argtypes=[c.c_wchar_p,w.DWORD,c.POINTER(SHFILEINFOW),c.c_uint,w.UINT]
shell32.SHGetFileInfoW.restype=c.c_void_p
SHGFI_ICON=0x100
SHGFI_LARGEICON=0
SHGFI_TYPENAME=0x400
SHGFI_USEFILEATTRIBUTES=0x10
FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY=0x10

class BITMAPINFOHEADER(c.Structure):
    _fields_=[("biSize",w.DWORD),("biWidth",c.c_long),("biHeight",c.c_long),("biPlanes",w.WORD),("biBitCount",w.WORD),("biCompression",w.DWORD),("biSizeImage",w.DWORD),("biXPelsPerMeter",c.c_long),("biYPelsPerMeter",c.c_long),("biClrUsed",w.DWORD),("biClrImportant",w.DWORD)]
class BITMAPINFO(c.Structure):
    _fields_=[("bmiHeader",BITMAPINFOHEADER),("bmiColors",w.DWORD*3)]
DIB_RGB_COLORS=0
DI_NORMAL=3
BI_RGB=0
def icon_hash(hicon,size=64):
    screen=user32.GetDC(None)
    mem=gdi32.CreateCompatibleDC(screen)
    bmi=BITMAPINFO()
    bmi.bmiHeader.biSize=c.sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER); bmi.bmiHeader.biWidth=size; bmi.bmiHeader.biHeight=-size
    bmi.bmiHeader.biPlanes=1; bmi.bmiHeader.biBitCount=32; bmi.bmiHeader.biCompression=BI_RGB
    bits=c.c_void_p()
    bmp=gdi32.CreateDIBSection(mem,c.byref(bmi),DIB_RGB_COLORS,c.byref(bits),None,0)
    old=gdi32.SelectObject(mem,bmp)
    c.memset(bits,0,size*size*4)
    ok=user32.DrawIconEx(mem,0,0,hicon,size,size,0,None,DI_NORMAL)
    data=c.string_at(bits,size*size*4) if ok else b""
    gdi32.SelectObject(mem,old); gdi32.DeleteObject(bmp); gdi32.DeleteDC(mem); user32.ReleaseDC(None,screen)
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() if data else ""

def sh_icon(path, use_attrs=False):
    info=SHFILEINFOW()
    flags=SHGFI_ICON|SHGFI_LARGEICON|SHGFI_TYPENAME|(SHGFI_USEFILEATTRIBUTES if use_attrs else 0)
    r=shell32.SHGetFileInfoW(path,FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY if use_attrs else 0,c.byref(info),c.sizeof(info),flags)
    if not r: return ("","","")
    h=icon_hash(info.hIcon)
    user32.DestroyIcon(info.hIcon)
    return (h,info.szTypeName,str(info.iIcon))

generic=sh_icon("folder",True)
print("GENERIC_FOLDER",generic,flush=True)
for name,s in ids.items():
    p=c.c_wchar_p()
    hr=shell32.SHGetKnownFolderPath(c.byref(guid(s)),0,None,c.byref(p))
    if hr<0 or not p.value:
        print("KNOWN_FOLDER",name,"UNAVAILABLE",hex(hr & 0xffffffff),flush=True); continue
    path=p.value
    ole32.CoTaskMemFree(c.cast(p,c.c_void_p))
    print("KNOWN_FOLDER",name,repr(path),sh_icon(path,False),"EXISTS",Path(path).exists(),flush=True)
